label: J1 of the modal join weakened to its selected-world instance: strength order, route and controls
summary:
Target: J1 of the modal spine's join (STMT-NO-CONTINGENT-CONCRETE-SUPPORT, NoContingentConcreteSupport = NoContingentGroundOfNecessary on the concrete subtype) on the routes to STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-UNDERIVED-AT. Analyst formulations, attribution deferred; no source read or claimed.

(a) Scope. J1 quantifies the support world v over every carrier world (accessible from w or not): any concretum existing at v that supports, at v, a concretum necessary from w is necessary from w. Its selected-world instance J1@w (new statement 84751fc2, ActualNoContingentConcreteSupport) constrains only supporters existing at w and support edges at w. J1@w is the existing STMT-ACTUAL-NO-CONTINGENT (ActualUnderivedEssenceEsse.ActualNoContingent) instantiated on the concrete subtype, as J1 is the generic all-world condition instantiated there; the named wrapper keeps J1 and its instance a strength-ordered pair on one domain and adds no content.

(b) Verified (Comparator and NanoDa pass on each; the first two zero-axiom): (1) actualOfNoContingent: J1 gives J1@w (instantiation); registered as a strengthens relation J1 -> J1@w. (2) underivedFromNecessityOfActualCoverage: STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT, actual well-founded grounding, J1@w, coverage (df42581f) and excluded middle give the join's endpoint. It composes the existing actual_source_not_not (ActualUnderivedEssenceEsse; on the concrete subtype, an actual necessary concretum with no concrete supporter existing at w, double-negated) with the existing presentSupportWF (NecessarySupportCoverage); excluded middle selects the witness and coverage transfers absence of actual support to every admitted world. It replaces J1 by J1@w in the existing underivedFromNecessityOfCoverage, which used J1 only at w. (3) controls: offWorldContingent (worlds false/true, universal access, t2 exists only at true; at false t0 supports t1, at true t2 supports t1) satisfies J1@w, the recorded replaceable-support rival SomeNecessaryConcretumContingentlySupported, every premise of the new route and of checks other than J1, and the endpoint, while J1 fails: strictness of the strength order. lateSupport (same worlds and existence; at false t0 supports t1, at true t2 supports t0) satisfies J1@w with every other premise of NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks, of its from-necessity assembly and of coverageOfNoContingentNoNovel (reflexive access, no-novel-edge), while J1, coverage and the endpoint fail. So J1@w cannot replace J1 on the two J2 routes or in that coverage bridge; those three arguments now record strong_version_needed with this control. underivedOfCoverage uses no form of J1, so it needed no re-derivation. The older underivedFromNecessityOfCoverage (9de79a41) keeps J1 in its frozen theorem though J1@w suffices; corpus check warns about it, correctly.

(c) Objection audit (substantive objection standard, 2026-11-12). The recorded rival to J1 is replaceable support (a necessary whole sustained by contingent constituents; #1447 assessment in docs/notes/underived-essence-identity.md, Replaceable support). Weakening to J1@w removes the conflict only with its off-world form (offWorldContingent); its recorded models (sustained whole; NecessaryWholeReplacement, where contingent c supports the necessary target at the selected world) already place the contingent support at the actual world and so also deny J1@w. Target and mechanism are named (bottom-up existential support of a necessary concrete whole by actual constituents that might not have existed), but no independent justification is recorded for the mechanism's key component: a concrete whole that exists necessarily while its numerical identity survives replacement of its sustaining constituents. The models fix a carrier label, not a defended identity criterion, and no source was read. So no substantive objection to J1@w is on file. Equally, no independent warrant for J1@w is on file: the strongest recorded positive argument (fixed indispensable existential dependence) covers particular essential supporters, not every actual supporter, and the 2026-11-11 provisional judgment (keep no-contingent support open; do not treat it as a consequence of necessity plus local foundation) applies unchanged to the actual instance. Premise status: J1@w open; no premise established; no root closure.
blocker: J1@w and coverage remain OPEN. Next discriminating tests: (1) an independent identity criterion for a specific candidate necessary concrete whole, testing whether replacement of its actual sustaining constituents preserves it (would give the replaceable-support rival substance against J1@w); (2) an argument that actual existential support of a necessary concretum entails the supporter's indispensability across accessible worlds without presupposing J1@w (would give it warrant); (3) whether the remaining J1 users (checks, its from-necessity assembly) can be rerouted through coverage, which with J1@w already reaches the same endpoint.
